{{Top|leg}}
A '''language convertor lexicon''' was an item of technology used before the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,098 BBY]], [[Dojundo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] made contact with the primitive [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]] species on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]]. The Hutts used language convertor lexicons to communicate with the Vodrans.
